rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unsophisticated or narrowly focused outlook.

example.english: They only ever read local news; it’s really parochial.
example.traditional: 佢成日只係睇自己區內嗰啲新聞，真係眼光狹窄。

rows.note: Use this attributive pattern specifically for matters belonging to a church parish.

example.english: We’re going to a parish event tonight, a parochial gathering just for church members.
example.traditional: 我哋今晚去參加堂區活動，係一個只限教友參加嘅聚會。
